verdict.rationale: The pack shows Flagsmith can toggle flags remotely without redeploying and markets a quick "kill switch", but nothing documents how changes reach connected SDKs. There is no streaming/SSE channel, polling interval, or propagation-latency figure. Remote toggling and the kill-switch use case are adjacent features, not evidence of propagation in seconds, and the Edge Proxy item concerns hosting location, not update delivery.

support.subject: As a developer, flag changes propagate to connected SDKs in seconds via streaming or fast polling — a kill switch actually kills
